# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We welcome students, educators, developers, and contributors of all backgrounds. Please help maintain a respectful and constructive learning environment.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and professional in issues, pull requests, and discussions.
- Offer actionable feedback about code and documentation, not personal criticism.
- Respect different experience levels and accessibility needs.
- Protect others' privacy; do not publish personal information or credentials.

Harassment, discriminatory language, intimidation, and personal attacks are not acceptable.

## Reporting and enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the repository maintainer privately through their GitHub profile rather than posting sensitive details in a public issue. Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content, close discussions, or restrict participation when needed. Reports will be handled as discreetly as reasonably possible; confidentiality cannot be guaranteed.

This policy applies to project spaces, including issues, pull requests, and project discussions.
